_comment: Commit J (2026-08-08): the uploader's IAM principal is PUT-ONLY. Lifecycle expiry removes objects; the instance never can. Without this, a compromised box deletes its own off-box copies and the third backup layer was decorative — the precise failure R1e exists to prevent. No DeleteObject, no DeleteObjectVersion, no PutLifecycleConfiguration, no PutBucketVersioning. The read-only Get* on bucket config exist solely so offbox_backup.sh's fail-closed assertions (region/SSE/versioning/lifecycle/public-access) can run. Attach per DEPLOY_RUNBOOK step 5; David provisions, never this repo.
